economicActivity.label: Coca-Cola system economic activity
economicActivity.period: calendar 2025 (Steward Redqueen 2026 assessment; newer than the Dec 2024 snapshot)
economicActivity.definition: Modeled contribution to GDP (value added) of The Coca-Cola Company plus its independent U.S. bottlers ("the Coca-Cola system"), including suppliers, distributors, retailers and re-spending of wages, from a Multi-Regional Input-Output model by consultancy Steward Redqueen. Published rounded ($2B, $443M); values in millions are converted to billions in the bracketed note.

jobsSupported.label: Jobs supported by the Coca-Cola system
jobsSupported.definition: Direct, supplier, value-chain and induced jobs the Coca-Cola system supports in the state, modeled by Steward Redqueen; published rounded as "23K+".

directEmployees.label: Direct Coca-Cola system employees
directEmployees.definition: Direct employees of The Coca-Cola Company and its independent bottlers in the state, per the study; published rounded as "3K+". Most are bottler employees, not TCCC employees.

employees.label: Company employees
employees.definition: Employees of The Coca-Cola Company located in the country (approximately)

footprint.notes: State rows come from The Coca-Cola Company's U.S. Economic & Community Impact map (company-hosted table for 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico and cities), a study by consultancy Steward Redqueen ("Steward Redqueen 2026 Assessment"; "reflective of the calendar year 2025"), so tier is company-commissioned and the period is newer than the Dec 2024 snapshot. An earlier Steward Redqueen study covered 2022 ($57.8B nationally, press release Sept 2023), but its state figures are no longer published; the live map shows only the 2025 study. All state figures cover the whole Coca-Cola system (TCCC plus independent bottlers), not the company alone, and are rounded by the source; Puerto Rico and city rows are left out; goods-and-services purchased and community investment columns not recorded. Regions: the 10-K facility table by operating segment; only the four geographic segments are recorded. Bottling Investments (61 owned and 4 leased bottling plants), Global Ventures (mostly 1,508 owned Costa retail stores) and Corporate are not geographic and are left out; distribution and retail columns not recorded. U.S. company employees 8,900 of ~69,700 total (10-K). No employees-by-state or taxes-by-country found.
